repairs.name: Authoring validation
repairs.before: author_result_contract_binding did not validate the supplied schema and did not verify schema_ref resolved to it; author_governed_rule did not validate result_contract; registry build validated only duplicate keys and duplicate families
repairs.after: author_result_contract_binding validates the schema with the same node validator, recomputes schema_ref and requires exact equality, then re-validates the finished binding; author_governed_rule re-validates the embedded contract, verifies the binding ref commits to it, and verifies the binding names the same rule id/version; V556RuleMaterialRegistry.build re-validates every embedded contract, family agreement, contract-ref agreement and rule_content_hash before any material can become GOVERNED_RULES_PRESENT
repairs.hash_mirroring: the recomputation mirrors the M3 seam exactly, including the contract_id re-insertion and the exclusion of binding_content_hash, so a stale or forged binding is refused at authoring rather than only at evaluation

repairs.name: Ontology / role gating
repairs.before: participant_roles were only non-empty and duplicate-free; enum values, primitive types and role labels were unconstrained, so ACTOR_DESIRE/ACTOR_BELIEF roles and DOMINATION/HEGEMONY/CAPITAL/PRESSURE_COUPLING enums and a pressure_magnitude number leaf were all authorable and positively evaluable
repairs.after: participant role labels are refused structurally on actor-semantic/person-state tokens; string enum values and exact-ref kinds are refused on blocked strong nouns; numeric scalar leaves (number and integer) are refused outright; OBJECTIVE_ACTOR_INDEXED is withdrawn rather than left as a dead accepted mode
repairs.vocabulary_source: every refused term is quoted from adopted law: blocked strong nouns from Field Forge R2 / OBL040 / OBL041 negative ceilings; the premise kinds from TD_R03 §5; no new synonym list was invented

repairs.name: Interaction semantics
repairs.before: PERMITTED_RELATION_KINDS was exactly COEXISTING_STRUCTURAL_INCIDENCE, SHARED_UPSTREAM_STRUCTURAL_CHANNEL and PARALLEL_STRUCTURAL_OCCURRENCE, which map one-to-one onto TD_R03 §5's forbidden non-inference premises, so the only authored relation vocabulary inverted the adopted non-inference law
repairs.after: those three names are retained only as TD_R03_NON_INFERABLE_F1_PREMISE_KINDS (premises a future governed rule may examine) and are refused in any authorable enum. AUTHORIZED_INTERACTION_RELATION_KINDS is empty, because TD_R03 §6 records that no complete governed interaction-rule authority exists. interaction_relation_canary_rule() now refuses, and V556_INTERACTION_RELATION is returned lawfully VALID_EMPTY
repairs.fabrication_refused: no replacement positive relation kind was minted to preserve the previous canary goal
repairs.td_r03_candidate_kinds_recorded_not_cano: TD_R03 §5 names flow continuation, rerouting, buffering, amplification, blockage, competition/counter-pressure, contradiction, reinforcement/destabilization, feedback and conditional coupling, then explicitly refuses to canonize them. They are recorded for traceability and are NOT authorable until a governed rule registry supplies them.

repairs.name: Topology canary
repairs.before: the canary declared maximum_cardinality_or_unbounded_marker=UNBOUNDED while the rule realized only n=2, so the maximum was false metadata; it structurally required a shared_structural_channel_ref, making it a shared-channel dyad rather than generic machinery; and it made no explicit statement about the F2 grain
repairs.after: the declared maximum is the truthful dyadic 2 and the seam refuses a third participant; the mandatory shared-channel field is removed so the shape is not structurally a shared-channel dyad; the material declares TOPOLOGY_CANARY_SHAPE_LABEL as one illustrative authorized shape and TOPOLOGY_CANARY_F2_CLAIM as explicitly NOT an F2 attractor-prerequisite topology; endpoint refs are bound to the real governed V555 route ref kind and validated against the rule's participant bindings

repairs.name: Registry and tranche ceilings
repairs.before: registry build did not check the frozen family set at all; one-rule-per-family existed only inside an exception string; OBJECTIVE_ACTOR_INDEXED was accepted but unsatisfiable; the admitted-role narrowing was undocumented
repairs.after: registry build enforces SUPPORTED_FAMILIES; one-rule-per-family is named data (TRANCHE_LOCAL_ONE_RULE_PER_FAMILY plus a note stating it is tranche-local and not a timeless ceiling, since M3 evaluates multiple distinct same-family rules); the admitted-role narrowing is recorded as TRANCHE_LOCAL_ADMITTED_ROLE_NARROWING naming what M3 also admits and why no architectural ceiling is claimed; OBJECTIVE_ACTOR_INDEXED is withdrawn with a stated reason

repairs.name: Court repair
repairs.before: 17 tests: 6 constant assertions on material the same tranche authored, 2 substring scans of the canaries only, 1 tautological no-op assertion, 1 test asserting a misspelled V556_ATTRACTOR_PREREQUISITE family name (vacuously None), and 1 test exercising the duplicate-KEY registry branch while claiming to prove the per-family branch
repairs.after: 35 machinery-level tests. Every commission-required hostile case is driven through the generic authoring/registry path rather than against canary instances: open schema via the binding path, person-state role via binding/rule/registry, actor-semantic participant labels, forbidden-premise and strong-noun enums, numeric scalar leaf, invented family at registry build, duplicate semantic-family with DISTINCT rule keys, truthful cardinality, payload-to-participant binding, OBJECTIVE_ACTOR_INDEXED behaviour, VALID_EMPTY no-rule behaviour, and attractor left unfilled. The misspelling, the tautology and the wrong-branch test are all removed. Three end-to-end tests prove the positive core still evaluates SUPPORTED through the unmodified seam with stable replay

repairs.name: Robustness
repairs.before: MappingProxyType was imported and never used; rule and contract material were live dicts inside a frozen dataclass so a post-authoring mutation registered with stale hashes caught only at evaluation; multiplicity_policy was only _text-checked so any string was authorable
repairs.after: material is deep-frozen via _freeze with a _plain inverse used for hashing and for handing M3 plain data, so a post-authoring mutation raises TypeError instead of registering; multiplicity_policy is frozen to the named MULTIPLICITY_POLICIES vocabulary

defects_found_while_implementing.defect: the binding validator initially required contract_id, but the M3 seam's exact binding field set excludes it
defects_found_while_implementing.severity: real: would have refused every lawful binding
defects_found_while_implementing.fix: the validator now enforces M3's exact 13-field binding set and mirrors the seam's hash construction, which re-inserts contract_id

defects_found_while_implementing.defect: the rule_content_hash recomputation in registry build omitted contract_id from the rule body material
defects_found_while_implementing.severity: real: every lawful rule was refused as stale
defects_found_while_implementing.fix: rule_body re-inserts contract_id and excludes only the authority triple and the hash itself

defects_found_while_implementing.defect: the payload-to-participant join preferred content_hash, but M3's route ref content_hash is semantic_hash(route) while the natural payload key is the route_id object_id
defects_found_while_implementing.severity: real: governed payload refs were wrongly refused
defects_found_while_implementing.fix: the governed identity set now carries both identifiers M3 commits to, and a payload ref matches either

defects_found_while_implementing.defect: the topology schema's allowed endpoint ref kind was the invented label V555_ROUTE_IDENTITY rather than the real governed V555 semantic family, so the seam returned INVALID_PARTICIPANT_SET
defects_found_while_implementing.severity: real: the repaired canary could not evaluate
defects_found_while_implementing.fix: the allowed kind is now the actual V555 semantic family constant

defects_found_while_implementing.defect: validate_payload_against_participants reported the derived unbound-field defect before the structural cardinality defect
defects_found_while_implementing.severity: ordering: a too-small participant set should be reported as the primary defect
defects_found_while_implementing.fix: the cardinality floor and maximum are now checked before field binding

court_bugs_found_in_my_own_repaired_cour: the distinct-family-branch test initially built a second binding bound to the FIRST rule's identity, tripping the correct binding/rule identity check instead of the family branch; the second binding is now bound to the distinct rule identity
the cardinality-floor test asserted a message that the field-binding check preempted; production ordering was corrected so the assertion became truthful
